notes.title: Bulanci: Battlefield DLC
notes.content:
[h3]For all the lovers of the Bulanci nation, we’ve got some big news today![/h3]

In our big update, the Bulanci will dive headfirst into the chaos of war.

In the new [b]BATTLEFIELD[/b] environment, several new gameplay elements emerge that can completely shake up your current tactics. Like any proper battlefield, you'll encounter military trenches and discover their advantages and pitfalls. If you prefer control, seize a heavy rotating machine gun for a while, which will earn you considerable respect on the battlefield. However, aerial bombs will rain from the sky, so you’ll need to stay constantly alert, especially when ice storms can ruin your escape plans at any moment.

Let's take a closer look at the features that will appear in the Battlefield environment.

[h2]Heavy Rotating Machine Gun[/h2]
It has unlimited ammo and can also act as a front shield. Whoever controls it can eliminate entire hordes of enemies. Not even a solid brick wall will save them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509720/92444de9c9668068c2c85d3a3437cbc387d9a8c4.png[/img]

[h2]Aerial Bombs[/h2]
To make things worse, enemy bombers are circling above. Luckily, you can somewhat predict the arrival of their bombs by the shrinking orange circle, but that’s not much comfort. Not even trenches will protect you from them. Our only advice – run!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509720/f3f6b4fb6394b8006e128d7932d371bd99b3c1b5.png[/img]

[h2]Ice Storm[/h2]
The bleak weather in the Battlefield environment is the complete opposite of a warm summer day in the Fairy Tale setting. Snow showers are common, and when combined with a sharp gale, you’re in for some trouble. Some soldiers will suddenly move faster, while others will crawl like snails trying to escape danger. Fortunately, the trenches provide a safe haven from the storm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509720/482763cc19106db9660b4ee3d76f9a649acd7a52.png[/img]

[h2]Trenches[/h2]
Two-level maps have been seen before, but the trenches are a bit different from their multi-story predecessors. In these narrow corridors, rocket launchers can explode right next to your face, and when you run out of bullets, there’s nowhere to run. You’ll need to think twice before charging into a long, narrow alley, especially with an enemy at the far end, gun at the ready. However, with ice storms and heavy machine gun bullets whizzing overhead, your decision might be a bit easier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509720/6d5f52dd2f44eae8abee441d5a803e2ff2e5b029.png[/img]

[h2]Barbed Wire[/h2]
This simple invention can make life quite unpleasant. However, for a Bulanek, protected only by a thin layer of fabric, such an encounter is fatal.

notes.title: Nintendo Switch - Release!
notes.content:
Extremely aggressive pillows are not just on Steam anymore. Bulanci have besieged the Nintendo Switch console as well now. 🌟 

On the enclosed map, you can see when the game is available in which region. With an improved user interface and artificial intelligence, the hero factory, and more stuff, the new version of Bulanci brings fun for up to eight players on one device.

notes.title: Nintendo is here!
notes.content:
Nintendo is here!

We are glad to announce the launch dates of Bulanci on Nintendo Switch!🌟

The launch on Nintendo is a global event, and below you can see when the game will be available in which region. The new version of Bulanci with an improved user interface and artificial intelligence, hero factory, and other enhancements will bring entertainment for up to eight players on one device.

[list]
[*] Los Angeles: 21. 12. at midnight PST
[*] New York: 21. 12. at 3:00 AM EST
[*] Sao Paulo: 21. 12. at 5:00 AM GMT+3
[*] London: 23. 12. at midnight GMT
[*] Prague: 23. 12. at midnight CET
[*] Hong Kong: 21. 12. at midnight HKT
[*] Tokio: 21. 12. at midnight JST
[*] Sydney: 23. 12. at midnight AEDT
[/list]

All enhancements will arrive to the PC version around Christmas as well, so you can expect a big update on Steam. You can also look forward to two brand new environments soon, Battleground and Maze. Battle tumult, aerial bombs, and a minigun will surely tear you a new hole in your pillowcases. On the other hand, a crazy Robocat lurks in the Maze, which is also full of moving walls, power outages, and a sewer system for quick movements. We are also working on new weapons, the Brutal mode, and many other surprises. There’s a lot in store for you.

notes.title: Bulanci leaves Early Access
notes.content:
After years of development and almost a year in Early Access, we’re proud to announce that Bulanci officially leaves Early Access and releases in full version. Believe us, however, that the work on the game is far from finished.

On both Steam and our website, you can find a roadmap that foreshadows our plans for the following months. There is much more in development still. In near future, you can look forward to several brand-new environments, the editor, the campaign and much more.

Bulanci will also launch on consoles, with the official release on Nintendo happening very soon and more console versions following shortly after. There is definitely a lot to look forward to.

Finally, we would like to thank you for your support. Whether you got the game via crowdfunding, bought it in Early Access, or downloaded the free version, we couldn’t have done it without you. Special thanks go to those who provided us with suggestions and ideas through social media or Discord, where a growing community of fans have formed.

The official release of a game is an important milestone, which means that one chapter of the life of Bulanci ends, but a new one begins. We would be happy if you joined us on this exciting journey, and we look forward to seeing you in the game or on Discord.

notes.title: Big Update #1 ver. EA 1.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509720/5ce342a64e0231effdeaaf4c20b7deb8a951af24.png[/img]

For all the lovers of the Bulanci nation, we’ve got some big news today!

In our first major update, Bulanci will infiltrate your room. 

In our new setting  KIDS ROOM, you can look forward to an interesting twist of the game mechanics. Face the feared robot, who goes around the room in all directions. Assault the kids’ train and take control over the battlefield. And the best for last – you will taste the battle to transcend you to higher levels of being!

Let’s take a look at three interesting objects, which will appear in the Kids room.

[h2]Trampoline[/h2]
The trampoline serves as a fast transport between individual levels. Run at the trampoline, wait for your Bulanek to jump on it, and whee… you fly to a higher level!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509720/7de41365a3b86ee157afb46845c90e78a39a1f97.png[/img]

[h2]Robot[/h2]
The robot is a merciless indomitable fighter. It moves in all directions and doesn’t differentiate between any kinds of feather!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509720/d68bf3139c64a0964e31886aaa8332a0625af339.png[/img]

[h2]Train[/h2]
Take a wild ride in the train! Just start the locomotive, and your pillowcase will flutter in the wind. You will gain one incredible advantage on top: as the first Bulanek in the world, you will be able to shoot in all directions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509720/2008e6c1be49dd6a4ba88e4b171dc8411c374c4a.png[/img]

There’s much more of it… Who is slow gets the blow! So let’s hurry to the Kids room!

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]

Online multiplayer is a highly anticipated addition to Bulanci, and we’re hard at work on it day and night. We understand you can easily defeat your loved ones already and have to test your mettle against some real machos in the online world.
Even though we are relatively close to finishing the multiplayer, we want for it to be just perfect. This is why we’ve decided to expand the ranks of our testers and allow you to be a part of it. Since today, we’ve opened the option to join the beta test of our online multiplayer. You can sign up through this form until March 15th:

[url=https://forms.gle/fm1sYxXbqXA5MLD66]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509720/05ee99ec5c8062a6d3ebfc28f5ee470a97611b33.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: DevLog #1 - Bulanci Hit Early Access!
notes.content:
Bulanci Hit Early Access!

Welcome to our first devlog. Let’s have a look at how far we managed to go thanks to everyone who had supported us.

More than 20 years ago, the world saw a tiny game called “Bulanci”, developed for desktop PCs, which found many fans in classrooms, households, offices, and PC cafés in Central Europe. There were even several expansions, and the game also received a mobile version later on. As time went by, the game ceased to catch up with new technologies and gradually became just a remote memory of cruel pillow fights.

In 2020, Bulanci awoke again, mainly thanks to the massive support on the Czech crowdfunding platform Startovac, where Bulanci became the most successful project in the history of this platform. And so, the idea to create Bulanci 2.0 became reality, and the game grew from a small remake to a full-fledged project, with many new features and expansions we’d never dreamt of.

Today, however, Bulanci are coming to you – only in Early Access for the time being, but that’s mainly because we are interested in your feedback and we want to allow you to participate in further development of the game with us.

Getting to this point was not a small feat; since the end of the crowdfunding campaign, there were several significant crises which shook the world, us included. In the end, though, we managed and we believe that the dedication we put into the game translated in proper battle mood. The Early Access brings three locations for now, which might spark nostalgia in players who are already familiar with Bulanci. These are the Fairy-Tale, the Factory, and Disco. Everything is new, however, and we also added team battles and Capture the Flag. You can play all of this with up to four friends using a single keyboard, or you can test your mettle against computer opponents. If you want to show Bulanci to your friends that are not next to you, you can invite them to play via Steam remote play.


[h2]And what is next for us?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509720/96fa67d60c772b933ffd9d8f3949d442698d5dcd.png[/img]

Things are only beginning for us now, and we are looking to getting feedback from all of you who want to influence further development of Bulanci.

In coming months, you can look forward to new maps, new locations and new game modes. We also plan to expand the history of Bulanci as well as the design of their appearance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509720/5081d10555a778b97de9351f7995a8a94f7f497f.png[/img]

We hope you will embark on this adventure with Bulanci and our whole team, and that the game brings you many hours of fun.

Sleep Team
